title: Architecture decision record
description: Keep an approved decision task in the repository as an architecture decision record: the request, the options, the decision and its reason, the committees' advice and the disagreements left, the conditions, the status and the exported decision record it comes from.

inputs.label: Decision task, approved, with its exported decision record

sections.title: Status
sections.prompt: Accepted, closed or still open, and the decision this one follows or replaces.

sections.title: Context
sections.prompt: The request as the task recorded it, and who it affects.

sections.title: Options considered
sections.prompt: The options on the table and what would make the team choose one.

sections.title: Decision
sections.prompt: The option chosen and the reason the person gave when approving.

sections.title: Committee advice and disagreements
sections.prompt: Each committee's verdict and recommendation, then the disagreements left open.

sections.title: Conditions
sections.prompt: The blockers the committees set, and whether each was cleared, waived or is still open.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.prompt: What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and what the team must now do or watch.

sections.title: Decision record
sections.prompt: The exported decision record this one comes from, and its seal.

checks.verification: Each option is named with what would make the team choose it, and the decision says why the others were not chosen.
The consequences say what becomes easier and harder, and what follows from each disagreement left open and each condition.
The exported decision record named under Decision record is in the repository and carries the decision seal written there.
